scripts.build: pnpm sync:orcid && pnpm validate:content && tinacms build --content=local -c "astro build" && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/report-build-output.ts production
scripts.build:local: pnpm sync:orcid && pnpm validate:content && tinacms build --local --skip-cloud-checks -c "astro build" && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/report-build-output.ts production
scripts.build:local:unchecked: pnpm sync:orcid && pnpm validate:content && tinacms build --local --skip-cloud-checks -c "astro build"
scripts.build:preview: pnpm sync:orcid && pnpm validate:content && cross-env EDITORIAL_PREVIEW=true tinacms build --local --skip-cloud-checks -c "astro build" && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/report-build-output.ts preview
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm exec astro check
scripts.test:publishing: pnpm build:preview && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert-build-output.ts preview && pnpm build:local:unchecked && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/report-build-output.ts production --allow-empty-production && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert-build-output.ts production
